claims.sentence: In response to this issue, ICLR 2026 desk-rejects papers that include hallucinated references \citep{iclr2026response}, and ICML 2026 lists them among its grounds for desk rejection \citep{icml2026ethics}.
claims.claim: ICML 2026 lists hallucinated references among its grounds for desk rejection.
claims.excerpt: Peer Review Ethics 2026 ... Peer-review Ethics This document outlines ICML standards for ethical conduct of peer review. ... Grounds for desk rejection of an individual submission include (but are not limited to): Placehlolder abstracts at abstract submission. ... Hallucinated references.
